ActorTalk: Attention, all members! The Gray Raven Commandant is currently visiting F.O.S., so we must put on our best performance later! We need to show the commandant how sincere the 【kuroname】 club is!
The 【kuroname】 Club is F.O.S.'s most influential unofficial organization... Wait... I-it's the Gray Raven Commandant!
You're our study group's role model!
Oh my god, I've been reading your post-combat reports!
I never thought I'd get to meet my idol up close like this...!
They're too fervent. Let's just leave.
